objectives: Decode taught sp-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the sp onset with the vowel and remaining sounds.
Distinguish sp from other taught blends without guessing.
Self-correct by checking every grapheme and rereading the whole word.
concepts: Decoding maps graphemes to sounds in order.
The sp onset contains s then p.
Every remaining grapheme must be decoded.
Rereading checks that no sound was omitted.

definitions.definition: A letter or group of letters representing a speech sound.
Use grapheme-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Notice and repair an error using sound and word evidence.

workedExamples.solution: Map s-p-i-n, blend the sounds, then say spin.
Keep s and p in order, then read the rest.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads spot as sot. What should happen?
workedExamples.solution: Return to p after s, map each grapheme, and reread spot.
